WELCOME TO THE GRID

Logic meets mayhem.

A Sudoku puzzle that fights back.

01

Solve & plant

Pick a blank, then a digit. Correct answers plant seeds and earn credits. Each row, column and box uses 1–9. Your recent answers shape the road.

02

Build your own weapon

War prep has no timer. Click a planted tower to upgrade it or equip up to five attachments. Stack electric modules, mix in frost, or build a rapid-fire cannon. Upgrade a number family to improve every matching seed for the entire run.

03

Defend & collect

Enemies drop fragments and sealed chests. Use consumables during combat for temporary boosts. Reserve seeds can break Sudoku rules, but illegal towers strengthen the wave.

04

Open, equip, repeat

Spend fragments to crack chests at camp. Buy passives, try the slots, and choose your next map. Gear returns to your bag each round. Campaign and Locked In run 50 rounds; Free Play is a single siege.

Keyboard Arrows: move · 1–9: place · I: inventory · U: tower upgrades · B: buy reserve · Enter: next phase · Space: pause · H: help

Controller D-pad: move / menus · LB/RB: number / tabs · A: select · RT: buy · LT: sound · B: bag / back · View: inventory · X: hint · Y: next phase · Start: pause
